— E-commerce

E-commerce website design

Design catalogue and product journeys that help shoppers make informed choices.

Ask about this service

What this work addresses

Store design must explain products and reduce uncertainty about purchase conditions. Category names, product comparison, variants, delivery details, and returns information all affect the journey. A polished hero image cannot compensate for unclear buying information.

How I approach it

I map browsing and product-selection needs, design representative templates, and review the mobile path to checkout. Important information is placed near the decisions it supports. Navigation and filtering are planned around the actual catalogue and platform constraints.

Potential deliverables

  • Category and product templates
  • Mobile shopping journeys
  • Checkout handoff review

Important considerations

Product facts, prices, delivery terms, and policy content must come from the business. Payment and checkout design may be constrained by the platform. Design changes should be evaluated against genuine purchases and customer feedback rather than assumed to improve conversion.

Preparing for a discussion

Share your current setup, the business outcome you want, and any known constraints. We can then define the useful boundaries of the work, required access, and how the agreed deliverables will be checked. Implementation and ongoing support are included only when agreed.

Common scope questions

Is implementation included?+

The scope may cover a review, recommendations, implementation, or a combination. We agree responsibilities and deliverables before starting so you know what is included in this e-commerce website design engagement.

Where does this fit in a wider plan?+

This is one part of e-commerce. The right starting point depends on the current setup and the business goal. Related work is recommended only where it addresses a practical dependency.
